items.a: TENET is an AI service aggregation platform. Through one OpenAI-compatible API, it connects you to ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek and more.
Currently OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4.1), Anthropic (Claude 3.7, 3.5) and DeepSeek (V3, R1), with more on the way.
Sign up → create an API key → call via the OpenAI-compatible API. Three steps and you’re live today.
Billed by actual model usage, transparent, no lock-in. New users get trial credits at signup.
